app.title: QuantumXLab
app.physical_lab_tooltip: Not observable on hardware — switch off Physical lab mode to use probes.

tooltip.Exact: Closed-form or exact linear algebra on the full state; error at machine precision.
tooltip.Numerical: Validated numerical solution of a differential equation with a stated error bound.
tooltip.Statistical: Sampled quantity; the interval shown is the 68.3 % Wilson interval.
tooltip.Model: Phenomenological or calibration-derived; correct in form, parameters from typical published ranges.
tooltip.Illustrative: Visual aid conveying a mechanism qualitatively; not a computed observable.

sim_only.tooltip: This quantity cannot be observed on a physical machine. It is computed from the simulator's state.

estimate_assumptions.queue_time_excluded: Wall time excludes any scheduler or queue wait on a shared machine.
estimate_assumptions.reset_policy:active: Qubits are reset by measurement followed by a conditional X (active reset); duration from device.json control.reset.
estimate_assumptions.reset_policy:passive: Qubits relax for 5·T1 (or the device repetition delay, whichever is longer) between shots.
estimate_assumptions.independent_errors: Gate, idle and readout errors are treated as statistically independent and multiplied.
estimate_assumptions.average_gate_fidelities: Each gate error is the average (Clifford-twirled) error rate from randomized benchmarking; coherent errors are not tracked separately.
estimate_assumptions.no_crosstalk: Classical drive crosstalk and ZZ during idles are neglected unless present in the calibration file.
estimate_assumptions.calibration_static: Calibration values are constant over the run (no drift, no recalibration).
estimate_assumptions.readout_from_calibration: Readout duration and assignment fidelity are taken from the device calibration.
estimate_assumptions.feedforward_latency: Each classical branch adds the device feedback latency to the critical path.
estimate_assumptions.idle_thermal_relaxation: Idle error per interval is the thermal-relaxation infidelity [2(1−e^{−t/T2}) + (1−e^{−t/T1})]/6.
estimate_assumptions.surface_code_scaling: Fault-tolerant estimates use p_L ≈ 0.1 (p/0.01)^((d+1)/2) with a rotated surface code and a 1.5× routing factor.
estimate_assumptions.host_benchmark: Classical cost uses the per-amplitude gate time measured on this machine at startup.
